source: https://shindex.uwu.network/data — the live Shelter plugin index (Cloudflare Worker) that shelter.uwu.network/plugins renders; each entry is fetched from its own author's site at run time and hash-verified before staging
note: Shelter starter set (5-10 popular real plugins, per AGENTS.md). Owner approval pending in QUESTIONS.md Q5; this is the recommended default and was used to keep moving. Every entry downloads at run time — nothing is vendored into the repository. The index also exposes 131 plugins across 40 repos for the bulk pass.

entries.name: Blur NSFW
entries.tier3: Open an NSFW-marked channel: images and videos are blurred and unblur on hover; other channels are untouched.

entries.name: Web Keybinds
entries.tier3: Set a keybind in shelter's plugin settings and press it in the app; must fire. Confirm Vencord's WebKeybinds is disabled alongside it — the plugin throws if both run.

entries.name: Antitrack
entries.tier3: Open a link that carries tracking parameters and confirm they are stripped before the request leaves.

entries.name: QuickReply Reloaded
entries.tier3: Right-click a message → Quick Reply: the reply box appears pre-filled and sends as a reply.

entries.name: Text Replacements
entries.tier3: Create a replacement, send a matching message, and confirm the text is swapped in the composer before sending.

entries.name: Hidden Channels
entries.tier3: With a locked channel visible in the sidebar, open it: the channel renders read-only and is marked hidden.

entries.name: Channel Typing Indicators
entries.tier3: In a channel where another account is typing, an indicator appears and disappears when they stop.

entries.name: Mention Controls
entries.tier3: Trigger a mention popup and confirm the controls the plugin adds behave as documented.

entries.name: FreeProfileColors
entries.tier3: Open your profile → Edit → theme colors: the plugin's colour pair applies and persists after reload.

entries.name: Back & Forward
entries.tier3: Use the plugin's back/forward controls (or its keybinds) to move between two channels and back.
